tools.name: about_mycryptoparadise
tools.description: Company facts about MyCryptoParadise: since 2016, MyCryptoParadise s.r.o. (Prague, reg. no. 23963581), founder Simon Mach, what the firm is and is not, and the scope of the third-party independent review of its signal record.

tools.name: list_insights_tools
tools.description: The live free market tools on mycryptoparadise.com (funding, open interest, liquidation map, order book walls, CVD, ETF flows, on-chain valuation, sentiment and more) with their URLs and what each one reads, plus the live MCP AI Indicators for TradingView and their guides.

tools.name: search_education
tools.description: Search the MyCryptoParadise guides, blog, MCP University FREE lessons and indicator guides (risk management, position sizing, chart patterns, Elliott Wave, Wyckoff, funding rates, open interest, judging a signals service). Returns title, URL, excerpt and date.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: The latest free MCP News articles from MyCryptoParadise: same day crypto market reads with a risk-first lens. Returns title, URL, publish time and the public one-line summary.

tools.name: explain_probability_points
tools.description: Explains the 0 to 5 probability points shown on MCP AI Indicators: how strong the tool's own reading is, the green and red meter, and No edge. They grade the reading, never where price goes next.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_insights_tools, search_education, get_news · Private data: about_mycryptoparadise · Public sink: get_news.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_insights_tools, search_education, get_news · Private data: about_mycryptoparadise · Public sink: get_news

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
